# exo_retention_policy (Data Source)

Look up an existing RetentionPolicy object. Set identity or name to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.
- `name` (String) Maps to the -Name parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `is_default` (Boolean) Maps to the -IsDefault parameter.
- `is_default_arbitration_mailbox` (Boolean) Maps to the -IsDefaultArbitrationMailbox parameter.
- `retention_id` (String) Maps to the -RetentionId parameter.
- `retention_policy_tag_links` (Set of String) Maps to the -RetentionPolicyTagLinks parameter.
